name: Wind Turbine SCADA Data for Early Fault Detection
summary: A real-world early-fault-detection benchmark containing 89 years of SCADA time series from 36 wind turbines across three wind farms.

characteristics.kind: Large labeled wind-turbine SCADA time series

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: SCADA observation time within an anonymized turbine event series.

attributes.name: sensor statistics
attributes.description: Per-timestamp average, minimum, maximum, and standard-deviation statistics; feature counts differ by wind farm.

attributes.name: status_type_id
attributes.description: Turbine-status label used for training-data quality filtering and anomaly evaluation.

attributes.name: event metadata
attributes.description: Fault descriptions, event timing, asset identifiers, and prediction intervals supplied with event series.

notes: Version 6 corrects labels, timestamps, units, and event descriptions from earlier versions.
The collection has 95 datasets: 45 lead up to labeled turbine faults and 50 represent normal behavior.
The provider recommends using average signals cautiously and documents implausible Min, Max, and Std values for some features.
The 5.5 GB archive is opt-in and is not downloaded by scripts/bootstrap.sh.
citation: Gück, C. and Roelofs, C. (2025). Wind Turbine SCADA Data For Early Fault Detection, Version 6. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.15846963
